newsitem.title: UK: UK retail prices rise yr/yr 2.7 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: UK retail prices rise yr/yr 2.7 pct in Feb.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics released the following retail price indices for February:
RETAIL PRICES INDEX Feb Jan Feb, 96
COMPONENT DETAILS OF THE ALL-ITEMS INDEX (PCT CHANGES) -
The ONS said the tax and prices index stood at 144.2 in February, up 0.4 percent on the month and 1.3 percent year-on -year.
The fall in the all-items 12-month rate was largely attributable to food prices, particularly seasonal foods.

Other smaller downward effects came from household goods' prices and personal goods' prices. There were upward effects on the 12-monthly rate form housing and motoring costs, and from clothing and footwear prices, the ONS said.
The was upward revaluation of the green pound will allow
agricultural prices to fall in coming months. The products most affected will be cereal sugar, beef , butter and skimmed milk powder, although this takes some time to feed through to retail prices.

The ONS said seasonal food prices generally rise in March. Fish prices are also on the increase as consumer fears over food safety has grown. Coffee price rises are on the horizon due to problems with the crop in several producer countries.
